dataset.selection: First 1000 rows in file order. Public trace points (relative milliseconds, x, y), alphabetic target, and derived encoder features only. User identifiers, session IDs, and prompt sentences are excluded.

preprocessing: points: raw trace as [relativeMilliseconds, x, y]. features: original NumPy two-stage linear interpolation (trace to approximately 60 Hz, then 64 points; x then y) as exact float32. lib/models/futo_swipe/src/trace_resampler.dart must reproduce features from points bit-for-bit. Fixed alphabetic QWERTY geometry and 26-key mask.

reference.runtime: ExecuTorch 1.2.0 / torch 2.11.0 Python binding on Apple M4 Max
reference.scope: Top-three candidates frozen from the original one-off ExecuTorch logits with the independent Dart CTC recurrence. This replay does not regenerate the ExecuTorch numerical comparison.
